{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or near-zero, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp upward moves in price (e.g., >70% from prior day).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias for 3-5 consecutive days of high volatility or downward drift.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history shows 0.00 for 3+ consecutive days.",
    "Correct for lagged overestimation by subtracting 5-10% from forecast if true outcome is consistently lower than model by 3-5% over 5 days.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.67 or higher, slightly increase forecast to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at 10% above recent peak.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, reduce forecast variance when sentiment is neutral or negative, especially if true outcome shows downward trend."
  ]
}
